entities.summary: Mahammad Abdullayev is an Azerbaijani boxer. He competed in the 2020 Summer Olympics at super heavyweight but lost to eventual winner Bakhodir Jalolov in the second round. He then contested the men's super heavyweight division at the 2021 World Championships, where he won a bronze medal.
